significance: A twelve-acre Shiva complex on the East-West Highway at Devchuli built by the CG Group and inaugurated by President Bidya Devi Bhandari on 7 March 2017. Besides the Ekambareshwor temple it holds a Vedic karmakanda gurukul, a yoga and meditation centre and a museum, and its pond is filled with water gathered from Badrinath, Kedarnath, Muktinath and Pashupatinath.
